title: AI4CAREER: Responsible AI for STEM Career Development at Scale in K-16 Education

bias_targets.methodology: Workshop-based evaluation and discussion of how AI-driven career systems risk reproducing disparities embedded in historical data, focusing on bias auditing, transparent recommendation logic, and diverse representation.
Examining structural barriers and cumulative access challenges for students with disabilities, such as deaf and hard-of-hearing learners, in AI-supported STEM education and career exploration tools.
